* Player cards cost 200 Rax
* Player cards have a unique serial #
* Player cards are tied to the season on the card
* Player cards earn Rax every game
* Collect Play cards to earn more Rax per Player card
* Use booster cards to earn more Rax per game for a player
* Unlock fun features for players

>
Claim a free player card or discounted team card for every sport every new season

**Player** card's can earn Rax **every** game based on a factor of performance Real rating.

* 🏈 **NFL**:
  * Offensive players 5x Real rating
  * Defensive players 7x Real rating
* 🏈 **CFB**:
  * Offensive players 5x Real rating
  * Defensive players 8x Real rating
* 🏀 **NBA**: 1x Real rating
* 🏀 **WNBA**: 2x Real rating
* 🏀 **CBB**: 2.5x Real rating
* 🏒 **NHL**: 1.2x Real rating
* ⚾️ **MLB**:
  * Batters 2x Real rating
  * Starting pitchers 3x Real rating
  * Relief pitchers 5x Real rating
* ⛳️ **Golf**: 3x Real rating
* ⚽ **FC**: 3.5x Real rating

You can view each player's total Rax earnings on every performance screen.

Playoffs and major tournaments are 2x more than the regular season base earnings. All sports have been scaled to be equal to each other over the course of a full season across the top 100 players earnings.

>
Earnings are sent the following morning at 7am EST for all player cards you hold. If a player gets a negative Real Rating, they will not be eligible to earn.

**Want to earn more Rax?**

Level up your Player cards by collecting their Play and Performance cards. The better the card's rating, the faster your players level up. Your player card's level is based on the sum of play and performance cards that you own for that player from the season listed on the player card. Negative play card ratings level up the card by their absolute value.

Every pack contains a booster card that you can apply to your player card on the day of a game. You must apply the booster before their game begins. They apply for one day only.

Booster cards have specific stat boost increases on the cards. The better the rarity the more boosted the stat.

Example: NBA Legendary 3-pointer booster earns 20 Rax per 3-pointer and a NBA Rare 3-pointer booster earns 12 Rax per 3-pointer. \
\
The booster cards come in 5 rarities:

🟠 **Rare Booster Card**

🔴 **Epic Booster Card**

🟣 **Legendary Booster Card**

🟡 **Mystic Booster Card**

💎 **Iconic Booster Card**

>
Unused boosters can be used the following season for a sport
Player cards come with the following features for the entire season:

You can set a custom avatar to your Player card that will appear everywhere for the player. Whether you're a fan of James Harden's iconic beard or prefer to represent him with a Twinkie, the choice is yours.

You can assign a nickname to your Player card, and it'll appear everywhere for that player. Name LeBron "The King" and Westbrook "The Queen", and watch every Lakers game on Real as The Queen dishes alley-oops to The King.

Your Player card and serial number appear below your comments. If you comment on that player's plays, performances, or reports, you'll rank above others with equal upvotes, and your comment will be highlighted.
Add a special avatar for yourself that shows where ever you leave comments for the player - on plays, performances, reports or in the player group.

Every Player card is broken up into tiers. Each time a new tier is reached, everyone with a Player card earns 10 Rax.

* Tier 1 = first 10 card-holders
* Tier 2 = first 20 card-holders
* Tier 3 = first 50 card-holders
* Tier 4 = first 100 card-holders
* Tier 5 = first 200 card-holders
* Tier 6 = first 500 card-holders
* etc...
